description: baseline: Phase 2 method (linear in depth within cast, linear in time between covering casts)
turbidity interpolated in log10 space (depth and time)
chl: nearest cast instead of blending when bracketing casts straddle a segment change (gain <0.002, simpler kept)
running median (5 readings) down each cast for turbidity and chlorophyll before interpolating
running-median window 9 instead of 5 (chl better, turb worse)
Gaussian time kernel (sigma 6 h, all casts) for turb and chl instead of linear bracketing
remove a fitted 24-h harmonic (per 1-m depth bin, vs 1-day running mean) before time interpolation, add back at query hour
add 12-h harmonic to the diurnal cycle fit
use each reading's own time (interpolated down the cast) instead of cast mid-time
chl running-median window 9 (turb stays 5); same complexity, lower score
turbidity in log10 throughout (cycle fit + interpolation); equal score, simpler kept
local PCHIP in time over 2 casts each side (turb/chl better, temp/cond worse; gain <0.002 for more complexity)
seasonally varying diurnal harmonic (refit every 3 d, sigma 10 d); gain <0.002 for more complexity
turbidity running-median window 3 (fifth non-improvement in a row: stop)

physics fix after stop: clip temperature to the range of the two bracketing casts (exp 9 put 19% of temp predictions up to 0.39 C outside it via the diurnal term; program.md rules that out). Score cost +0.0007; kept as best compliant version
